title: Gym Management System (GMS)
tagline: Complete solution for managing gyms, members, and memberships
description: Gym Management System is a comprehensive platform designed to streamline gym operations. Whether you're managing a single gym or overseeing multiple fitness centers, GMS provides all the tools you need to succeed.

features.name: Member Management
features.description: Easily manage member profiles, track membership status, and maintain emergency contact information.

features.name: Membership Plans
features.description: Create & customize flexible membership plans with different durations and pricing options.

features.name: Payment Tracking
features.description: Monitor payments, track payment status, and generate detailed payment reports for financial analysis.

features.name: Multi-Gym Support
features.description: Super-admin can manage multiple gyms with dedicated admin dashboards for each gym owner.

features.name: Real-time Notifications
features.description: Get instant notifications for important events like expiring memberships and payment updates.

features.name: Detailed Reports
features.description: Generate comprehensive reports for collections, member status, and financial performance.

features.name: Data Export
features.description: Export gym data to Excel with organized sheets for gyms, members, plans, and payments.

features.name: Role-Based Access
features.description: Secure role-based access control with separate portals for super-admins and gym owners.

changes: Initial release of Gym Management System
